bio: Night photographer. Long exposures, wet streets, and the stories light tells after the shops close.
avatar: Portrait of a man in his early 40s with round glasses and a camera strap around his neck, city lights bokeh behind him, calm expression, shoulders-up, photographic, fictional person
banner: Ultra-wide panoramic long-exposure photograph of a night city bridge with light trails and a glowing skyline, subject across the middle band, cinematic

collections.title: After dark
collections.description: A city, after the shops close.

videos.title: Light trails on the bridge
videos.description: A twenty-second exposure turned into a moving picture.
videos.still: Wide long-exposure photograph of a city bridge at night with red and white light trails and a glowing skyline over water, no people, no text
videos.motion: Car lights stream across the bridge in glowing trails, the water shimmers, slow gentle camera push-in.

videos.title: Tripod, rain, patience
videos.description: Setting up in the rain for a single shot.
videos.still: Vertical photograph of a camera on a tripod on a rainy night street with neon reflections on the wet ground, the photographer standing far away seen from behind, no text
videos.motion: Rain falls steadily, neon reflections ripple on the wet ground, slow camera push-in toward the camera.

videos.title: Empty crossing, 3 a.m.
videos.description: A traffic light cycling for no one.
videos.still: Vertical photograph of an empty city intersection at 3am with traffic lights glowing red and green reflections on wet asphalt, no people, no readable text
videos.motion: The traffic light changes colour and reflections shift on the wet road, subtle slow push-in.

videos.title: Rooftop view, blue hour
videos.description: The sky between day and night, over a sea of rooftops.
videos.still: Wide photograph of a city skyline at blue hour from a rooftop, windows beginning to glow, deep blue sky, no people, no text
videos.motion: Windows light up one by one and clouds drift across the sky, slow push-in.
